name: btn-rotating-gradient

frames.best_why: Bright gradient ring fully visible around the centred dark pill, with no cursor over the label.

tagline: Dark pill button with a thin gradient ring that spins around its edge.
summary: A rounded call-to-action button with white text and a thin two-tone conic gradient that circles its border, making the outline brighten and fade as it travels.
appearance: A centred pill-shaped button on a near-black stage: dark navy interior with white 'Book a demo' text, enclosed by a thin ring that shifts between pale blue and white as it circles the button.
behaviour: The conic gradient ring spins steadily around the button's outline, so the border brightens and dims as the colours travel. The button itself stays still; the source adds a focus ring on keyboard focus.
demo_content: The button label reads 'Book a demo'.
search_phrases: call to action with moving border
dark pill button with light outline
use_when: A primary action on a dark hero needs to draw the eye without loud colour or size.
avoid_when: Busy pages or light themes: the dark pill and fixed purple-blue gradient may clash with brand colours.
customise: Pass the label as children and a className to extend the button; the gradient colours, spin speed and radius are fixed in the source and need editing.
weight_why: Two spans and a single CSS spin animation; no JavaScript or canvas.

a11y.note: The spinning border ignores prefers-reduced-motion, so motion-sensitive users get a perpetual animation; a native button keeps it keyboard-operable.

issues: The pale ring is very faint in frames 1 and 2, so the effect is easy to miss.
polish_why: Tidy pill with a smooth, even spin; the gradient ring is too faint to notice in some frames.
